reason: The README describes a coding-agent design skill whose primary purpose is generating and refining frontend UI layouts and design systems, with additional presentation and graphics workflows.

summaries.zh: 面向编程智能体的设计技能，可读取项目上下文并生成、迭代前端界面、设计系统、演示文稿和图形设计。
summaries.en: A coding-agent design skill that uses project context to generate and iterate frontend interfaces, design systems, presentations, and graphics.

capabilities: reads project code for design context
writes design-system and HTML replica files
invokes a CLI for prompt search and design operations
uses external web services for design references and generated drafts
creates and iterates UI, presentation, graphic, image, and video designs
